verdicts.why: presentFaceLine prints '<name> is <activity>.' from the live row (v2.py:12300-12306). Every row in 7_final_game.toml read after '<Name> is', first and last minute: Ryan in his room / waiting for the bathroom / in the shower / eating / on the couch / asleep (wd 23-07, we 23-10); Laura making breakfast / making dinner / watching TV with Mark (Mark in living room wd 16:30-23, true every minute) / asleep / having a slow breakfast (we 08-12) / on the couch (we 19-23, not 'with Mark', true on Saturday when he's at the bar); Mark having coffee before work (wd 07-07:30) / in his chair / asleep / having breakfast (we 08-10) / at the kitchen table (Sun 10-12); Tom behind the counter; Chris at the machine; Nina/Frank/Danny behind the till; Hale lecturing / in his office hours; Pratt teaching / in his office; Walsh teaching / in her advisor hours; Cross teaching drama / running rehearsals; Nadia in psychology / at lunch / studying; Holt at the desk; Rosa at the counter; Vance on his porch; Marco training. All true for their hours; campus and hood people have no met-flag setter yet, so their faces don't show (quest-card gate, v2.py:12284-12286). Popups: the 13 toast=false keys are counters, day-turn markers and seen-once flags; each one the player should feel is said on its own screen ('That's this week done, kid.' for rent_handled_this_week, the first-payment line and count for rent_paid_once). met_*, cafe_hired, cafe_first_shift_done, pays_her_own_way and start_* keep their popups (no label, toml:298-361).
No moment alone with her body added; the shower/bed faces ('Ryan is in the shower.', 'Ryan is asleep.') are someone else's row.
No scene with a person; nothing goes a step further.
NpcBusyPage is one generated line plus Back (v2.py:229-231); no scene to end on a hook, and the card puts menus behind idle faces out of scope.
She says and does nothing on the busy page or the toast.
No act of hers added for anyone to notice.

Only activity strings and labels changed; hours unchanged (who_is_where for Ryan/Laura/Mark matches PLAN §9a rows and the People-page tips, e.g. Mark 'at the kitchen table on Sunday mornings' = Sun 10-12 kitchen row). No garment named.
